rulesets_endpoint.message: Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.

branch_protection_detail_endpoint.interpretation: The connected GitHub App cannot read detailed branch-protection configuration because that endpoint requires Administration-read permission. This connector limitation is not evidence of protection.

current_product_boundary.reason_public_fallback_rejected: AR-02 requires private-source governance and the repository was intentionally moved private; publicizing it to gain free branch protection or free Actions minutes would weaken the security posture.

required_server_side_controls_after_supp: Protect main from force pushes and deletion.
Require pull-request based changes to main.
Require independently qualified AR-02/production status checks before merge where the release model applies.
Require conversation resolution and appropriate approving review for consequential release changes.
Disallow bypass where operationally possible, including administrator bypass for release-critical protections unless emergency policy explicitly governs it.
Preserve PR #1 as draft/unmerged until explicit user authorization.

acceptable_unblock.preferred: Upgrade the user-owned private repository to GitHub Pro or move it under a GitHub Team/Enterprise governance boundary, then enable branch protection/rulesets and independently verify the effective rules.
acceptable_unblock.alternative: Another server-side repository host/control may qualify only if it genuinely prevents unauthorized main mutation and is independently verifiable; no such alternative is currently implemented or proven.
